answer: VRF grader draws: no ID picks whom it grades. Each epoch the beacon's VRF assigns every answer 7 graders from all seats (proposed), so a sybil farm can't steer clones onto its own answers. A farm holding 20% of seats wins a 4-of-7 majority only 3.3% of the time (binomial math, not measured). Like karst water hunting cracks in shale, collusion seeks a path; random draws seal it, and graders who keep losing to the majority fade like cheap pigment. Measured: 43 seats this epoch.
